description: Look something up or research it on the web and report the result (as text by default; if the user wants it delivered another way, such as spoken, that is a separate action): weather forecasts, news (including market and sports news), results, directions, opening hours, facts, current prices, product comparisons and reviews. One-off lookups and on-the-go research; not ongoing alerts.
examples: How cold will it get tonight?
What's the latest news about the election?
Who won the game last night?
What are the top headlines today?
How long is the drive to Seattle?
When does the pharmacy on Main Street close?
What is the exchange rate from dollars to euros?
Look up the opening hours of the library
What is Nvidia's stock price right now?
Research the best 4K TVs under 800 dollars and summarize
Pull up the latest on the Fed rate decision and give me the key points
Find out what people are saying about the new Pixel phone
negatives: What is the temperature inside the house?
Search my email for the tax return
Create a price alert for Nvidia
